description:
Code review of the 7 cloud Spark platform adapters (5,358 LOC total) identified
significant duplication opportunities. Approximately 1,100-1,400 lines of code
can be consolidated through mixins and improved base classes.

Adapters reviewed:
- Dataproc Serverless (710 LOC)
- Athena Spark (858 LOC)
- EMR Serverless (849 LOC)
- Synapse Spark (888 LOC)
- AWS Glue (841 LOC)
- Snowpark Connect (690 LOC)
- Databricks DataFrame (522 LOC)
